about: Catalogue expansion for the beta. Facts (year, length, credits) were compiled from general knowledge; where an open source matches a work, its values replace these and the change is recorded (fact_sources). Terms, advisories and summaries are AI-assisted readings awaiting editorial review. Ratings are unverified.

works.title: Seven Samurai
works.summary: A poor farming village hires seven masterless samurai to defend it from bandits at harvest time.

works.title: Rashomon
works.summary: A bandit, a samurai's wife, the samurai's ghost and a woodcutter give contradictory accounts of the same crime.

works.title: Princess Mononoke
works.summary: A cursed young prince is caught between an ironworks town and the gods of the forest it is destroying.

works.title: Howl's Moving Castle
works.summary: A young hatmaker cursed into old age takes refuge in the walking castle of a vain, frightened wizard.
ratings: Frightening images and brief mild language

works.title: The Boy and the Heron
works.original_title: 君たちはどう生きるか
works.summary: A boy grieving his mother follows a talking grey heron into a world between life and death.
ratings: Violent content, bloody images, smoking and some language

works.title: Your Name
works.summary: A Tokyo boy and a girl from a lakeside town find themselves switching bodies, and trying to meet.
ratings: Thematic elements, suggestive content, brief language and smoking

works.title: Akira
works.summary: In a rebuilt Neo-Tokyo, a teenage biker gang member gains psychic powers that threaten the city all over again.

works.title: Grave of the Fireflies
works.summary: In the last months of the Second World War, a teenage boy and his little sister try to survive alone after firebombing destroys their home.

works.title: Tokyo Story
works.summary: An elderly couple travel to Tokyo to visit their grown children, who are too busy for them.

works.title: Shoplifters
works.summary: A makeshift family living on small thefts takes in a neglected little girl from a neighbour's balcony.

works.title: Drive My Car
works.original_title: ドライブ・マイ・カー
works.summary: A grieving stage director staging Uncle Vanya in Hiroshima is assigned a quiet young driver, and the long drives open up both of them.

works.title: A Silent Voice
works.summary: A former school bully seeks out the deaf girl he tormented years before.

works.title: Oldboy
works.summary: A man imprisoned in a hotel room for fifteen years without explanation is released and given five days to find out why.

graphic-violence: A brutal corridor fight and torture.

ratings: Strong violence including torture, sexuality, nudity and language

works.title: Memories of Murder
works.summary: Two mismatched detectives in rural 1980s Korea chase a serial killer with little more than instinct and brutality.

works.title: Train to Busan
works.summary: A workaholic father and his daughter board a high-speed train just as a zombie outbreak sweeps Korea.

works.title: The Handmaiden
works.summary: In 1930s Korea under Japanese rule, a pickpocket is hired as maid to a secluded heiress as part of a con.

works.title: Burning
works.summary: A young delivery worker reconnects with a childhood acquaintance, then grows obsessed with the rich man she brings back from Africa.

works.title: Decision to Leave
works.summary: An insomniac detective falls for the enigmatic widow he suspects of killing her husband.

works.title: Past Lives
works.summary: Two childhood sweethearts separated when one family emigrates from Seoul reconnect twice across twenty-four years.

works.title: In the Mood for Love
works.summary: In 1962 Hong Kong, two neighbours discover their spouses are having an affair and slowly fall for each other.

works.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
works.summary: A legendary sword is stolen, and a warrior, his old companion and a rebellious young noblewoman are drawn into a duel of loyalties.
ratings: Martial arts violence and some sexuality

works.title: Farewell My Concubine
works.summary: Two Peking opera performers' lifelong bond is tested across fifty years of Chinese political upheaval.
ratings: Language, some drug use, violence and sexuality

works.title: Yi Yi
works.summary: A year in the life of a middle-class Taipei family, from a wedding to a funeral, seen partly through the eyes of an eight-year-old.

works.title: Amélie
works.summary: A shy Montmartre waitress decides to secretly improve the lives of the people around her, while avoiding her own.

works.title: The Intouchables
works.summary: A wealthy aristocrat paralysed in an accident hires a young man from the projects as his live-in carer.

works.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
works.original_title: Portrait de la jeune fille en feu
works.summary: In eighteenth-century Brittany, a painter secretly paints a reluctant bride-to-be's portrait, and the two fall in love.
ratings: Nudity, sexuality and some drug use

works.title: The Seventh Seal
works.summary: A knight returning from the Crusades to a plague-stricken Sweden plays chess with Death to buy time.

works.title: Persona
works.summary: A nurse is sent to a seaside cottage with an actress who has stopped speaking, and their identities begin to blur.

works.title: La Dolce Vita

works.title: The Zone of Interest

works.title: Anatomy of a Fall
works.summary: A writer is put on trial for her husband's death, and their partially blind son becomes the key witness.
ratings: Language, some sexual references and violent content

works.title: Another Round
works.summary: Four burnt-out schoolteachers test a theory that life goes better with a constant small amount of alcohol in the blood.

works.title: The Worst Person in the World

ratings: Sexual content, graphic nudity, drug use and language

works.title: City of God

ratings: Strong brutal violence, pervasive drug use and language, and for some sexuality

works.title: A Separation
works.summary: A Tehran couple's separation sets off a chain of events with the carer hired for the husband's father.

works.title: Capernaum
works.summary: A twelve-year-old boy in the slums of Beirut sues his parents for bringing him into the world.
ratings: Language, some drug content, and brief nudity

works.title: Wild Tales
works.summary: Six stories of ordinary people pushed past breaking point, each more vengeful and absurd than the last.

works.title: The Secret in Their Eyes
works.summary: A retired legal counsellor writes a novel about an unsolved rape and murder case that has haunted him for twenty-five years.
ratings: A rape scene involving violence, some graphic nudity and language

works.title: Pather Panchali
works.summary: In a Bengal village, young Apu and his sister Durga grow up in poverty as their father seeks work far away.

works.title: Sholay

works.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
works.summary: Two young Indians from London fall in love on a European holiday, but her father has already promised her to someone in Punjab.

works.title: Lagaan

works.title: 3 Idiots

works.title: Taare Zameen Par
works.summary: An eight-year-old who struggles at school is sent to boarding school, where a new art teacher realises he is dyslexic.

works.title: Dangal
works.summary: A former wrestler trains his daughters to become world-class wrestlers in a village that thinks girls shouldn't.

works.title: The Lunchbox
works.summary: A Mumbai lunch delivery goes to the wrong man, and the lonely widower and the neglected wife who cooked it begin exchanging notes.

works.title: RRR
works.summary: In 1920s India, two revolutionaries on opposite sides become friends before their missions collide.

works.title: Baahubali: The Beginning
works.summary: A young man raised by villagers below a giant waterfall climbs it and learns he is heir to a stolen throne.

works.title: Drishyam
works.summary: A cable TV operator who knows the world through films uses everything he has learned to protect his family after a death.

works.title: Kumbalangi Nights
works.summary: Four estranged brothers in a fishing village near Kochi slowly learn to become a family.

works.title: Super Deluxe
works.summary: Four interlocking stories in Chennai over one strange day: a dead body, a returning father, a porn video and a meteor.

works.title: Jai Bhim
works.summary: A lawyer takes on the case of a tribal woman whose husband disappeared in police custody.

works.title: Andhadhun
works.summary: A pianist who pretends to be blind accidentally witnesses a murder, and can't admit he saw it.

works.title: Queen
works.summary: Jilted days before her wedding, a sheltered Delhi woman goes on the European honeymoon alone.

works.title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
works.summary: Three childhood friends take a bachelor road trip across Spain, each secretly facing a fear.

works.title: Gully Boy
works.summary: A young man from Mumbai's Dharavi slums finds his voice as a street rapper.

works.title: Swades
works.summary: A NASA scientist returns to India to bring his childhood nanny back to America, and finds himself drawn into village life.

works.title: 12th Fail
works.summary: A boy from a village in Chambal who failed his school exams sets out to pass the civil-service exam and become a police officer.

works.title: Laapataa Ladies
works.summary: Two veiled brides are switched on a crowded train, and each has to find her own way in a strange village.

works.title: Tumbbad
works.summary: Across three generations, a man returns to a cursed village to steal gold from a god who was never meant to be worshipped.

works.title: Vikram Vedha
works.summary: An honest cop hunting a gangster is told three stories by his quarry that unsettle his sense of right and wrong.

works.title: Manjummel Boys
works.summary: A group of friends on a trip to Kodaikanal must save one of them when he falls into a deep cave.

works.title: Dil Chahta Hai
works.summary: Three inseparable college friends drift apart as love takes each of them in a different direction.

works.title: Rang De Basanti

works.title: Kahaani
works.summary: A pregnant woman arrives in Kolkata during the Durga Puja festival to search for her missing husband.

works.title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
works.summary: A devout, good-hearted man sets out to take a lost mute Pakistani girl home across the border.

works.title: Free Solo
works.summary: Climber Alex Honnold prepares to scale the 900-metre face of El Capitan without a rope.
ratings: Some language and brief injury images

works.title: My Octopus Teacher
works.summary: A filmmaker in burnout dives daily in a South African kelp forest and forms a bond with a wild octopus.

works.title: Man on Wire
works.summary: How Philippe Petit and his friends plotted to walk a high wire between the Twin Towers in 1974.
ratings: Some sexual content, nudity and drug references

works.title: The Act of Killing
works.summary: Former Indonesian death-squad leaders cheerfully re-enact their mass killings for the camera.

works.title: Won't You Be My Neighbor?
works.summary: The life and philosophy of Fred Rogers, who spent decades on television telling children they were loved.

relationships: Miyazaki's two great forest films, one gentle and one at war.
Quiet Tokyo lives observed with patience.
Bong Joon-ho's earlier, bleaker look at power and class.
Two people, one city, a lot of talking about what might have been.
Patient films about noticing ordinary lives.
